bodyFindings.where: The pull request body, Not proven / risk, the entry added this round for main.go's wiring.
bodyFindings.claim: 'The budget's behaviour is proven by a live two-handler test, but its wiring is read, not executed.'
bodyFindings.why: No such test exists. No Test function in cmd/listener builds two delivery handlers: every construction site is one handler per run (unplaceable_delivery_acceptance_test.go:222 and :722 are the only two, each in a different helper). The two-handler run it refers to is mine from round three - a throwaway probe I wrote, drove and deleted, recorded in that round's handoff as 'a throwaway probe (since removed)' - and the qualifier was dropped when the sentence was written. What does lock the behaviour is the keyed-set pair, TestUnplaceableDeferralsStopAtTheirCap and TestARedeliveryThisListenerNeverDeferredGivesNoSlotBack, which pass a preloaded set through the config: replacing the constructor's panic with a per-handler set fails both of them and two more, as round three recorded. So the substance of the entry is right and only the evidence it names is wrong.
bodyFindings.correction: Name the tests that exist. For example: 'The budget's behaviour is proven by the tests that pass a preloaded set through the config (TestUnplaceableDeferralsStopAtTheirCap, TestARedeliveryThisListenerNeverDeferredGivesNoSlotBack), which a per-handler set fails; its wiring is read, not executed.'
